svg.aria-label: Four measured network configurations: fitted curves, validation error, epoch-mean minibatch gradient norm, and actual learning rate. Independent synthetic sets contain 96/240/400 train/validation/test observations with noise standard deviation 0.2. Initial parameters and batch ordering match; AdamW additionally uses the stated decay and schedule.
